G401.et: from a comparative of (303) and cheo (to pour)
G401.def: from a comparative of «303» and cheo (to pour); properly, effusion, i.e. (figuratively) license:--excess.

G402.def: from «303» and «5562»; to retire:--depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self.

G403.def: from «404»; properly, a recovery of breath, i.e. (figuratively) revival:--revival.

G404.def: from «303» and «5594»; properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively) relieve:--refresh.

G405.et: from a derivative of a compound of (435) and (4228)
G405.def: from a derivative of a compound of «435» and «4228»; an enslaver (as bringing men to his feet):--menstealer.

G407.def: middle voice from «435»; to act manly:--quit like men.

G408.def: from «435» and «3534»; man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite:--Adronicus.

G410.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (1458)
G410.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «1458»; unaccused, i.e. (by implication) irreproachable:--blameless.

G411.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (1555)
G411.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «1555»; not expounded in full, i.e. indescribable:--unspeakable.

G412.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (1583)
G412.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «1583»; not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable:--unspeakable.

G413.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (1587)
G413.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «1587»; not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible:--that faileth not.

G414.def: comparative of a derivative of «430»; more endurable:--more tolerable.

G415.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «1655»; merciless:--unmerciful.

G416.def: from «417»; to toss with the wind:--drive with the wind.

G417.def: from the base of «109»; wind; (plural) by implication, (the four) quarters (of the earth):--wind.

G418.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as (1735)
G418.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as «1735»; unadmitted, i.e. (by implication) not supposable:--impossible.

G419.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (1830)
G419.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «1830»; not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable:--unsearchable.

G420.def: from «430» and «2556»; enduring of ill, i.e. forbearing:--patient.

G421.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of (1537) and a derivative of (2487)
G421.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of «1537» and a derivative of «2487»; not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable:--past finding out; unsearchable.

G422.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of (1909) and (153)
G422.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of «1909» and «153»; not ashamed, i.e. irreprehensible: --that needeth not to be ashamed.

G423.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (1949)
G423.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «1949»; not arrested, i.e. (by implication) inculpable:--blameless, unrebukeable.

G425.def: from «447»; relaxation or (figuratively) relief:--eased, liberty, rest.

G426.def: from «303» and etazo (to test); to investigate (judicially):--(should have) examined(-d).

G428.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «2111»; not well set, i.e. inconvenient:--not commodious.

G430.def: middle voice from «303» and «2192»; to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with:--bear with, endure, forbear, suffer.

G431.et: from (1) (as a particle of union) and an obsolete nepos (a brood)
G431.def: from «1» (as a particle of union) and an obsolete nepos (a brood); properly, akin, i.e. (specially) a cousin:--sister's son.

G433.def: from «303» and «2240»; to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper:--convenient, be fit.

G434.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and hemeros (lame)
G434.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and hemeros (lame); savage:--fierce.

G435.def: a primary word (compare «444»); a man (properly as an individual male):--fellow, husband, man, sir.

G436.def: from «473» and «2476»; to stand against, i.e. oppose:--resist, withstand.

G437.et: from (473) and the middle voice of (3670)
G437.def: from «473» and the middle voice of «3670»; to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise:--give thanks.

G439.def: from «440»; a bed of burning coals:--fire of coals.

G440.def: of uncertain derivation; a live coal:--coal of fire.

G442.def: from «444»; human:--human, common to man, man(-kind), (man-)kind, men's, after the manner of men.

G443.def: from «444» and kteino (to kill); a manslayer:--murderer. Compare «5406».

G444.et: from (435) and ops (the countenance, from (3700)); man-faced, i.e. a human being
G444.def: from «435» and ops (the countenance; from «3700»); man-faced, i.e. a human being:--certain, man.

G445.def: from «446»; to act as proconsul:--be the deputy.

G446.def: from «473» and a superlative of «5228»; instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul:--deputy.

G447.def: from «303» and hiemi (to send); to let up, i.e. (literally) slacken or (figuratively) desert, desist from:--forbear, leave, loose.

G448.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «2436»; inexorable:--without mercy.

G449.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (3538)
G449.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «3538»; without ablution:--unwashen.

G450.def: from «303» and «2476»; to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive):--arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up(-right).

G451.def: of Hebrew origin («02584»); Anna, an Israelitess:--Anna.

G452.def: of Hebrew origin («02608»); Annas (i.e. «367»), an Israelite:--Annas.

G453.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (3539)
G453.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «3539»; unintelligent; by implication, sensual:--fool(-ish), unwise.

G454.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and (3563)
G454.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and «3563»; stupidity; by implication, rage:--folly, madness.

G455.def: from «303» and oigo (to open); to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications):--open.

G458.def: from «459»; illegality, i.e. violation of law or (genitive case) wickedness:--iniquity, × transgress(-ion of) the law, unrighteousness.

G459.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «3551»; lawless, i.e. (negatively) not subject to (the Jewish) law; (by implication, a Gentile), or (positively) wicked:--without law, lawless, transgressor, unlawful, wicked.

G460.def: adverb from «459»; lawlessly, i.e. (specially) not amenable to (the Jewish) law:--without law.

G461.et: from (303) and a derivative of the base of (3717)
G461.def: from «303» and a derivative of the base of «3717»; to straighten up:--lift (set) up, make straight.

G462.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «3741»; wicked:--unholy.

G464.def: from «473» and «75»; to struggle against (figuratively) ("antagonize"):--strive against.

G465.def: from a compound of «473» and «236»; an equivalent or ransom:--in exchange.

G467.def: from «473» and «591»; to requite (good or evil):--recompense, render, repay.

G470.def: from «473» and «611»; to contradict or dispute:--answer again, reply against.

G471.def: from «473» and «2036»; to refute or deny:--gainsay, say against.

G472.et: from (473) and the middle voice of (2192)
G472.def: from «473» and the middle voice of «2192»; to hold oneself opposite to, i.e. (by implication) adhere to; by extension to care for:--hold fast, hold to, support.

G473.def: a primary particle; opposite, i.e. instead or because of (rarely in addition to):--for, in the room of. Often used in composition to denote contrast, requital, substitution, correspondence, etc.

G475.def: from «473» and «1303»; to set oneself opposite, i.e. be disputatious:--that oppose themselves.

G476.def: from «473» and «1349»; an opponent (in a lawsuit); specially, Satan (as the arch-enemy):--adversary.

G477.def: from a compound of «473» and «5087»; opposition, i.e. a conflict (of theories):--opposition.

G478.def: from «473» and «2525»; to set down (troops) against, i.e. withstand:--resist.

G479.def: from «473» and «2564»; to invite in return:--bid again.

G480.def: from «473» and «2749»; to lie opposite, i.e. be adverse (figuratively, repugnant) to:--adversary, be contrary, oppose.

G482.et: from (473) and the middle voice of (2983)
G482.def: from «473» and the middle voice of «2983»; to take hold of in turn, i.e. succor; also to participate:--help, partaker, support.

G483.def: from «473» and «3004»; to dispute, refuse:--answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay(-er), speak against.

G485.def: from a derivative of «483»; dispute, disobedience:--contradiction, gainsaying, strife.

G486.def: from «473» and «3058»; to rail in reply:--revile again.

G488.def: from «473» and «3354»; to mete in return:--measure again.

G489.def: from a compound of «473» and «3408»; requital, correspondence:--recompense.

G490.def: from Antiochus (a Syrian king); Antiochia, a place in Syria:--Antioch.

G491.def: from «490»; an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia:--of Antioch.

G492.def: from «473» and «3928»; to go along opposite:--pass by on the other side.

G493.et: contracted for a compound of (473) and a derivative of (3962)
G493.def: contracted for a compound of «473» and a derivative of «3962»; Antipas, a Christian:--Antipas.

G494.def: from the same as «493»; Antipatris, a place in Palestine:--Antipatris.

G495.def: from «473» and «4008»; on the opposite side:--over against.

G496.def: from «473» and «4098» (including its alternate); to oppose:--resist.

G497.def: from «473» and «4754»; (figuratively) to attack, i.e. (by implication) destroy:--war against.

G498.et: from (473) and the middle voice of (5021)
G498.def: from «473» and the middle voice of «5021»; to range oneself against, i.e. oppose:--oppose themselves, resist.

G499.et: neuter of a compound of (473) and (5179)
G499.def: neuter of a compound of «473» and «5179»; corresponding ("antitype"), i.e. a representative, counterpart:--(like) figure (whereunto).
